triggerRule: Original transport carries an original soldier and has moved at least128 from its original near-embark pose.
responseRule: One initial enemy warship attacks that real hull, then holds at its observed sinking position; no spawn/delete/teleport or tick trigger.

deaths.note: Only original native source and original authority at observation time; empty attribution is not invented.

scope: Native main AI behavior baseline only. Physical behavior and missing formal fact/requote/attribution evidence remain distinct; a never-triggered scene does not prove interruption handling failed.
